changelog: Initial launch of ParcelFlow unified cross-platform application for Android & iOS
Unified Role-Based Access: Resident, Staff, and Admin portals within a single binary
Resident Portal: 14 high-polish screens including pickup slot booking, dynamic secure OTP countdown, QR code generation, and authorized collector management
Staff Portal: 16 high-efficiency screens including camera barcode/AWB scanner, storage rack assignment (Racks A & B), queue manager, and instant OTP verification
Admin Portal: 14 management screens matching official design reference including real-time KPI metrics, resident & staff directory, slot configuration, and reports
Supabase real-time sync with robust offline caching and fallback handling
ParcelFlow signature retro-cartoon design system with chunky borders, tactile depth, and responsive typography
